title: Pre-operative cardiac review

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documenting clinician-led cardiovascular disease and risk-factor review, use of an already completed validated risk assessment, selective testing decisions, and team-based discussion.
user_facing_items.population: Adults undergoing noncardiac surgery with cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk factors, or symptoms concerning for cardiovascular disease.
user_facing_items.setting: Preoperative cardiovascular assessment and perioperative planning for noncardiac surgery.
restrictions: Exact for a stepwise clinician-led cardiovascular risk assessment, selective testing, team-based review, and anticoagulation risk context. It does not support automatic risk scores, tests, medicine changes, bridging, or doses, and UAE pathways remain local.
user_facing_items.rationale: The ACC/AHA key points support a stepwise clinician-led preoperative cardiovascular assessment, selective testing, functional and risk context, and team decisions without calculating risk or granting clearance.
